profile.name: 实验室成像相机
profile.description: 用于实验室图像采集的相机系统，可发现并连接不同相机，执行单帧或多帧采集，读取图像缓冲区与设备信息，并支持视场、焦距、校准以及底层寄存器/内存访问。该类设备可覆盖普通可见光相机，也可能包括热成像或高光谱相机。
profile.description_en: A laboratory imaging camera system used for image acquisition in lab setups. It can discover and connect cameras, perform single or multi-frame capture, provide image buffers and device metadata, and support field-of-view, focal length, calibration, and low-level register/memory access. This device class may include visible-light cameras as well as thermal or hyperspectral cameras.

registry.name: Service Signal
registry.description: Camera Service是一款表征设备，主要功能包括中止、关闭、写入数据、启动、成像、打开。支持Signal, Slot, activeCamera等操作。
